user.title: Sign in with GoodWe
user.description: Use the same email and password you use in the GoodWe app. Your charger is found automatically — there is no serial number to look up.

charger.title: Which charger?
charger.description: This account has more than one. Choose the one you want in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: That GoodWe email and password were not accepted. Check them in the GoodWe app and try again.
error.no_chargers: Signed in successfully, but no EV charger is listed on this account. Check the charger appears in your GoodWe app.

abort.already_configured: That charger is already set up.
